# Social Safety & Anti-Griefing Requirements Quality Checklist: Online Multiplayer & Social

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, độ đầy đủ, độ rõ ràng và tính an toàn chống phá hoại/gian lận trong các yêu cầu của tính năng `010-multiplayer-social` (Presence, Safe Chat, Friends, Party, Co-op Homestead, Disconnect/Reconnect).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all six online presence states (`ONLINE`, `IN_HOMESTEAD`, `IN_DUNGEON`, `AWAY`, `DISCONNECTED_HOLD`, `OFFLINE`) and the exact `5-minute` inactivity threshold explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all Party lifecycle actions (`CREATE`, `INVITE`, `ACCEPT`, `DECLINE`, `LEAVE`, `KICK`, `TRANSFER_LEADER`, `START_DUNGEON` Ready Check, auto-disband) and member cap (`1..4`) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are both allowed co-op actions and explicitly forbidden anti-griefing actions (`HARVEST`, `COLLECT`, `BUILD`, `DEMOLISH`, storage, enhancement) unambiguously enumerated for `PARTY_ACCESS` homestead visits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 Are friend list capacity (`50`), pending request capacity (`20`), request expiry (`7 days`), and block list capacity (`100`) all explicitly bounded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK005 Are chat safety limits (`1..250` UTF-8 chars, plain-text XSS sanitization, `5 msg / 10s` rate limit, `60s` auto-mute after `3` violations in `1 min`, `50-msg` RAM ring buffer) quantified with objective values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Are loot fairness rules (`PERSONAL_INSTANCED` default, `ROUND_ROBIN` forced override for `RARE`+/`BOSS_TOKEN`/Boss drops, `>= 5%` damage/healing/mitigation eligibility, `<= 96 px` pickup range, `120s` TTL) unambiguously specified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Are disconnect/reconnect timings (`5s` Combat Logout Grace vs `120s` Party/Dungeon slot reservation) and post-reconnect landing destinations (live instance vs safe zone if died during grace) clearly distinguished? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §US4]

## Consistency & Constitution Alignment

- [ ] CHK008 Do all persistence and ephemeral-memory boundaries consistently enforce 100% local JSON files (`data/db/parties/<partyId>.json`, `characters/`, `houses/`, `audit/`) and in-process RAM without Redis, PostgreSQL, or third-party chat/presence services? [Consistency, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK009 Are server-authoritative enforcement rules consistent across chat sanitization, loot pickup ownership, homestead permissions, and single-active-session enforcement without trusting client claims? [Consistency, Constitution §II]

## Edge Cases, Anti-Griefing & Concurrency Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Are race conditions on simultaneous `ACCEPT` at `3/4` Party capacity and mutual friend acceptance addressed with deterministic serialization/deadlock avoidance? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are anti-griefing protections specified for banning `KICK` during active Boss encounters, preventing invite spam (`15s` cooldown after `DECLINE`), disabling player-to-player body-blocking, and instantly ejecting guests upon `PARTY_ACCESS` revocation? [Security, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are capacity claims (`50` CCU MVP, `< 200 ms` local chat latency) transparently marked `proposed / unverified` and MVP vs post-MVP social features (`WHISPER`, `GUILD`, `Trade`, `PvP`) clearly bounded in Assumptions? [Honesty, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-005, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
